context: The corrected CHAT-88 (supersedes the stopped batch-i, which was staged only in ~/Buildo-wt-rulrec2 and never committed; its HELDOUT-1 premise was wrong). The 2026 values-only notice batches coa-2026-a, b and c ARE the 172-notice set (scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/floors-172.json "dataset"), the set the exception rounds were tuned on, so there is no held-out round on them. HELDOUT-1 is restated as a rule for future notice batches; PLANFACTS-1 is as recommended before. Both approved in one message.

decisions.subject: Every new CoA notice batch is first scored blind, then folded into a cumulative all-notices headline set
decisions.recommendation: No held-out round on coa-2026-a, b, c: they are the 172 set. Every NEW CoA notice batch added after 2026-10-23 is first scored in a pre-registered blind round (the oracle C pre-registration form, CHAT-63 C-4, M-321), then folded into a cumulative all-notices set that becomes the headline score, held to the same floors (92 accuracy / 71 answered, 900.3.10 = 86; M-322). The 172 and 4d sets stay frozen as reference pins. A fold-in that drops below a floor goes to the operator; no silent adjustment.

decisions.subject: Phase 3 validation also uses the plan facts as reference values
decisions.recommendation: Use the 129 plan facts (coa_plan_facts: heights, GFA and unit counts from the applications, values only) as reference values for Phase 3 calculation validation (queue P4), alongside the operator golden cases (M-327). They are already read by the scorer, but only for survey lot dimensions (M-308). The golden case ranks higher where the two disagree and every disagreement is listed (M-326 order of authority); plan facts are never calculator input (M-333) and set no floor by themselves (M-330).
